config.global.enabledWorkspaces.descript: List of workspace names where ForgeVSC is enabled. Leave empty to enable the extension for all workspaces.
config.workspace.additionalPackages.desc: Additional packages/extensions to fetch metadata from. By default, installed Forge packages are detected automatically. This property is only needed if metadata fetching fails or you want to include extra packages.
config.workspace.customFunctionPaths.des: Path(s) to your custom functions folder(s). This is used to generate metadata and to provide full extension feature support for your custom functions.
config.workspace.formatting.function.sty: The font style used for function prefix names.
Default font style, no special formatting.
Formats function names in **bold**, making them stand out.
Formats function names in *italics* for a subtler distinction.
Formats function names in ***bold and italics*** for maximum emphasis.
config.workspace.colors.function.name.de: The highlight color used for function names.
config.workspace.colors.function.name.pa: Input must be a valid hex color, e.g. #AC75FF
The highlight color used for function dollar signs ($).
Input must be a valid hex color, e.g. #FE7CEB
config.workspace.colors.function.semicol: The highlight color used for function semicolons (;).
Input must be a valid hex color, e.g. #C586C0
config.workspace.colors.arguments.condit: The highlight color used for argument condition operators.
Input must be a valid hex color, e.g. #4FC1FF
config.workspace.colors.operators.negati: The highlight color used for the negation operator (!).
Input must be a valid hex color, e.g. #4FA3FF
config.workspace.colors.operators.silent: The highlight color used for the silent operator (#).
Input must be a valid hex color, e.g. #FF9F43
The highlight color used for the count operator (@[x]).
Input must be a valid hex color, e.g. #33D17A
config.workspace.colors.operators.countD: The highlight color used for the count operator delimiter (separator).
Input must be a valid hex color, e.g. #76E3A0
config.workspace.features.folding.descri: Whether folding for multi-line function contents should be enabled.
config.workspace.features.hoverInfo.desc: Whether hover info cards for functions and operators should be enabled.
config.workspace.features.suggestions.de: Whether suggestions for bracket placement should be enabled.
Whether signature help for function arguments should be enabled.
config.workspace.features.diagnostics.de: Whether diagnostics for function validation should be enabled.
config.workspace.features.autocompletion: Whether autocompletion for functions and arguments should be enabled.
config.workspace.rpc.enabled.description: Whether to enable the custom Discord RPC (Rich Presence) for this extension.
config.workspace.rpc.details.description:
The first line of the activity, shown while editing a file. Leave empty to hide.

**Placeholders:**

- `{file_name}`: Name of the active file, e.g. `index.ts`
- `{file_extension}`: Extension of the active file, e.g. `ts`
- `{language}`: Language of the active file, e.g. `TypeScript`
- `{workspace}`: Name of the workspace
- `{folder}`: Name of the directory the active file is in
- `{line}`: Current cursor line
- `{column}`: Current cursor column
- `{total_lines}`: Total number of lines in the active file
- `{git_branch}`: Current Git branch, empty if unavailable
- `{extension_version}`: Installed ForgeVSC version

Discord requires 2 to 128 characters. Longer text is truncated. Text shorter than 2 characters hides the line.
config.workspace.rpc.state.description:
The second line of the activity, shown while editing a file. Leave empty to hide.

Supports the same placeholders as `#forgevsc.workspace.rpc.details#`.
config.workspace.rpc.detailsIdling.descr:
The first line of the activity while idling. Leave empty to hide.

Supports the same placeholders as `#forgevsc.workspace.rpc.details#`. Placeholders that depend on an open file, such as `{file_name}` or `{line}`, are empty while idle.
config.workspace.rpc.stateIdling.descrip:
The second line of the activity while idling. Leave empty to hide.

Supports the same placeholders as `#forgevsc.workspace.rpc.detailsIdling#`.
config.workspace.rpc.largeImageText.desc:
The tooltip shown when hovering over the large image of the activity. Leave empty to show no tooltip.

Supports the same placeholders as `#forgevsc.workspace.rpc.details#`.
config.workspace.rpc.smallImageText.desc:
The tooltip shown when hovering over the small image of the activity. The small image shows the icon of the active file's language. Leave empty to show no tooltip.

Supports the same placeholders as `#forgevsc.workspace.rpc.details#`.
config.workspace.rpc.swapImages.descript:
Whether to swap the large and small images of the Discord activity. By default the large image shows the BotForge logo and the small image shows the icon of the active file's language. When enabled, the language icon becomes the large image and the logo becomes the small image.

While idle there is no language icon, so this setting has no effect then.
config.workspace.rpc.timestamp.descripti: Controls which elapsed time is shown on the Discord activity.
config.workspace.rpc.timestamp.enum.sess: Show the time since the extension started in this window. The timer keeps running when you switch files.
config.workspace.rpc.timestamp.enum.file: Show the time spent in the current file. The timer restarts whenever you switch to a different file.
config.workspace.rpc.timestamp.enum.none: Do not show an elapsed time.
config.workspace.rpc.idleTimeout.descrip:
The minutes without activity (typing, saving, switching files or moving the cursor) before the Discord activity switches to the idle activity. Activity resumes as soon as you interact with the editor again.

Set to `0` to never switch to the idle activity.
config.workspace.rpc.showRepositoryButto:
Whether to show a **View Repository** button on the Discord activity. Nothing is shown if the workspace has no Git remote.

Discord allows at most 2 buttons in total, so this button takes one slot from `#forgevsc.workspace.rpc.buttons#`. Buttons are only visible to other users, not on your own profile.
config.workspace.rpc.buttons.description:
The custom buttons to show on the activity. Discord allows at most 2 buttons in total, including the repository button, which is placed first. Extra buttons are ignored.

Buttons are only visible to other users, not on your own profile.

Example:
```json
[{ "label": "Join my server", "url": "https://discord.gg/example" }]
```
config.workspace.rpc.buttons.label.descr: The text shown on the button. Maximum 32 characters.
config.workspace.rpc.buttons.url.descrip: The URL opened when the button is clicked. Must start with `http://` or `https://`.
config.workspace.rpc.buttons.url.pattern: The URL must start with http:// or https://
config.workspace.rpc.ignoredWorkspaces.d:
The names of workspaces or workspace folders for which no Discord activity is shown. Any activity already shown is cleared while one of these is open. Use this to keep private or work projects off your profile.

Matches the workspace name or the name of any of its folders exactly, e.g. `my-secret-bot`.
